messages.subject: Idea: dedicated DevRel hire
messages.body:
Hi Marta!

Idea I can't stop thinking about: a dedicated DevRel hire. Someone who writes the integration guides, speaks at courier-tech meetups, works the developer communities — all the things I do at 20% capacity and badly.

Our API is becoming the product as much as the dashboard is, and we have zero developer-facing content right now. Indicative cost for a mid-level person would be €70–80k. I've got a rough role sketch here (share.parcelwise.example/chloe/devrel-role-sketch) if you want a peek!

Chloe

messages.subject: RE: Idea: dedicated DevRel hire
messages.body:
Dear Marta, dear Chloe,

Just to note for the record: a DevRel hire at €70–80k would be a meaningful addition to the payroll, and with Elena's role budgeted and the senior backend search concluding, I would want us to be clear on the revenue case before adding a third hire this year. That is not an objection to the concept — developer content could well support the API usage revenue — merely a caution about the sequencing.

Kind regards,
Helen
Helen Oyelaran | Chief Financial Officer | Parcelwise B.V.
